# NEAR Ecosystem Yield & Participation Report (as of November 3, 2026)

## 1. Native Staking: Current Yield Environment

NEAR's **gross staking yield measured 5.268%** as of September 22, 2026 (mainnet block 216,701,043) [S1]. This is consistent with the protocol formula in NEAR Docs: validator yearly yield ≈ **2.25% × total supply / total stake**, derived from the 2.5% annual reward budget with 10% routed to the treasury [S11]. Cross-check: 2.25% × 1,306,946,399 / 558,165,227 ≈ 5.27% [S1, S11].

| Metric | Value (measured Sept 22, 2026) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Spot price | $4.30 (cross-checked Kraken, Coinbase, CoinGecko) | [S9] |
| Total supply | 1,306,946,399 NEAR | [S1] |
| Total staked | 558,165,227 NEAR (42.71% of supply) | [S1] |
| Gross staking yield | 5.268% (at 2.5% issuance cap) | [S1] |
| Active validators | 406 (100 block producers, 306 chunk-only) | [S1] |
| Proposal queue | 459 candidates waiting for a seat | [S1] |
| Minimum active stake (validator seat) | 9,428 NEAR | [S1] |
| Issuance split | 90% staking participants / 10% treasury | [S1] |
| Mainnet validator seats | 500 (top 100 produce blocks) | [S11] |

**Key dynamic:** In the two weeks before measurement, ~54.5M NEAR was unstaked as the staking ratio fell from 46.92% to 42.71% during a price rise from $2.31 to $4.30 — yet gross yield *rose* from 4.796% to 5.268% because the staked denominator shrank [S1].

**Validator selection criteria:** Validators with <90% uptime in an epoch earn **no reward** for that epoch; rewards are reduced between 90–99% uptime [S11]. Active validator lists are viewable on platforms like NEAR-STAKING [S11]. Note: 269 of 424 validator pools do not cover operating costs from commission alone at spot (302 at 1.6% issuance), indicating long-tail attrition risk [S14].

### Forward Yield Risk: HSP-029 Issuance Ramp
Governance proposal **HSP-029** (posted Oct 7, 2026) would ramp maximum annual emissions from 2.5% to **1.6% over 24 months**, cutting gross staking yield from 5.268% to **3.372%** at the 1.6% target [S1]. The proposal argues stake responds to price and liquidity opportunity cost rather than emission rate, and cites Solana's ratification of an equivalent change (SGP-0002, 67.001% of stake) on Aug 28, 2026 [S9]. At the 1.6% target, 24 of 405 pools would lose economic self-sufficiency at spot [S9]. This proposal is **not yet ratified** — it is the dominant forward-looking risk to NEAR staking yields.

## 2. Liquid Staking: Providers, Mechanics & Trade-offs

NEAR Docs list three major mainnet liquid staking providers [S2]:

| Provider | Mainnet Contract | Exit Paths | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Meta Pool | `meta-pool.near` | 4-epoch unstake OR instant DEX swap | MetaPool's node studio credited in governance discussion as supporting validator set health [S14] |
| Rhea Finance | `lst.rhealab.near` | 4-epoch unstake OR instant DEX swap | Rhea.finance DEX is the documented swap venue for liquid-token exits [S2] |
| Linear | `linear-protocol.near` | 4-epoch unstake OR instant DEX swap | Same liquid-staking interface [S2] |

**Mechanics:** Call `deposit_and_stake` with NEAR attached to receive the liquid token; rewards accrue through the underlying validators [S2]. To exit natively: `unstake_all`, wait the standard **4 epochs (~24–28 hours per NEAR Docs)**, then `withdraw_all` [S2]. For immediate liquidity, swap the liquid token for NEAR on a DEX like **Rhea.finance** without waiting [S2].

**Risk/return trade-off:** Liquid contracts delegate across multiple top-performing, actively monitored validators, making reward loss from a single validator outage extremely unlikely — but the **average reward rate is typically slightly lower** than delegating directly to a single high-performing validator [S2, S13].

### Native vs. Liquid Staking Comparison

| Dimension | Native Validator Delegation | Liquid Staking (stNEAR / LiNEAR / Rhea LST) |
|---|---|---|
| Gross yield | Up to ~5.27% via a top validator [S1, S11] | Slightly lower average rate [S13] |
| Exit liquidity | 4-epoch unstake delay (~24–28h) [S2] | Instant via DEX swap on Rhea.finance [S2] |
| Validator risk | Concentrated in one pool; uptime penalties [S11] | Diversified across top validators [S13] |
| Incremental risk | None beyond validator performance | Smart contract risk; DEX slippage/price deviation [S2, S13] |

**Live stNEAR/LiNEAR APYs are not published in the retrieved evidence**; both track the underlying validator reward rate (~5.27% gross, marginally lower net of diversification) [S1, S13].

## 3. DeFi Yield Pools & DEX Liquidity

Rhea.finance is documented as the DEX venue for swapping liquid staking tokens back to NEAR [S2]. However, **no specific NEAR DeFi pool APYs, TVLs, or LP fee-tier data appear in the retrieved evidence** — this remains a coverage gap.

## 4. NEAR HACKATHON: Build Beyond Boundaries — $250,000 Prize Pool

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Total prize pool | **$250,000** [S3] |
| Build window | Nov 1, 2026 00:00 UTC – Nov 14, 23:59 UTC [S3] |
| Judging / results | Nov 16–18; results announced by Nov 18, 23:59 UTC [S3] |
| Sign-up | None required in advance; solo or team [S3] |
| Submission requirements | Public repository + public demo post on X (video or screenshots, mention NEAR HACKATHON); form asks for project name, 20–2,000 char description, team lead + email, team size, preferred track, NEAR account address for prizes [S3] |
| Tracks (13 total) | Unstoppable DeFi, Investment Thesis, Privacy & Private AI, Autonomous Business, AI Swarms, AI Security & Defense, Agent Economy (list continues in source) [S16] |
| Tooling | NEAR Intents, Chain Signatures, chain abstraction, NEAR AI Cloud, TEEs, 1-Click Swap SDK, function-call keys, meta transactions, sub-accounts [S16] |
| Support | HACKATHON.md guidance, NEAR Discord for questions, @NEAR_hckthn for updates [S15, S16] |

**Per-place prize breakdown (grand prize, 1st place, etc.) is not disclosed in the retrieved sources** — only the $250,000 total is documented [S3]. As of this report date (Nov 3, 2026), the build window is **open with 11 days remaining**.

## 5. Grants & Ecosystem Participation

The NEAR funding portal (near.org/funding) lists five channels [S4]:

| Program | Focus |
|---|---|
| Ecosystem Grants | Apply for NEAR grants to fund your project [S4] |
| Protocol Rewards | Metrics-based rewards tied to development activity and user adoption [S4] |
| Devhub Grants | Funding and support for tooling [S4] |
| Potlock | Discover impact projects, donate directly, join funding rounds [S4] |
| Meta Pool Grants | Meta Pool growth initiatives: DeFi, Education, TVL Generation, Brand Awareness [S4] |

Grant amounts, deadlines, and eligibility criteria are not published in the retrieved evidence.

## 6. Coverage Gaps
- **Per-validator APY/commission ranking:** only the aggregate 5.268% gross yield is documented [S1]; the RPC snapshots retrieved were NEAR **testnet** endpoints (27 validators), not mainnet staking data [S7].
- **Live stNEAR/LiNEAR APYs:** only provider contracts and mechanics documented [S2].
- **DeFi pool APYs/TVLs and DEX LP fee data:** absent from evidence.
- **Hackathon per-place prize breakdown:** only the $250,000 total is documented [S3].
- **Grant amounts, deadlines, eligibility:** not published [S4].
